title: Lesson 1 - Object Permissions: CRUD, System vs Object, Profiles vs Permission Sets
description: Given a scenario, recommend the right level of object permissions needed to provide the appropriate access to a set of users.

questions.question: An architect needs to let a small group of support managers read every Account record, including records owned by other divisions, without granting them system administration. Which approach best fits?
options: Give each manager a profile with Read on Account
Create a permission set granting View All on Account and assign it to the managers
Set the Account org-wide default to Public Read Only
Give the managers Modify All on Account
questions.explanation: View All on Account bypasses sharing so they can read all records without any admin/system permission. Changing the OWD affects everyone, and Modify All also grants Edit, exceeding the need.

questions.question: Which statement about profiles versus permission sets is TRUE?
options: Permission sets can remove object permissions granted by the profile
A user must be assigned at least one permission set
Permission sets add permissions on top of the profile and never take them away
Profiles can be assigned multiple per user
questions.explanation: Permission sets are purely additive; the profile is the single baseline and permission sets extend it. A user can have zero permission sets and exactly one profile.

questions.question: Why is a permission set group preferable to assigning several individual permission sets to a large cohort of users?
options: It bundles multiple permission sets so users receive the combined permissions with one assignment, and it supports dynamic assignment
It can remove a permission that the profile grants to all users
It changes the users' profile automatically
It grants record access without any object permissions
questions.explanation: A permission set group packages several permission sets for a single assignment and supports dynamic assignment rules, reducing admin overhead for large cohorts. It cannot remove profile permissions, change profiles, or grant record access by itself.
